API reference
=============

Generated with ``sphinx.ext.autodoc`` from the docstrings in ``module_4/src``.
Each page covers one layer (see :doc:`../architecture`), and a ``[source]``
link beside every object opens its code.

The assignment's "Flask routes" module is ``webapp.routes``: the application
is a package (``webapp``) with an application factory, rather than a single
``flask_app.py`` file.
